g.text: tetrisd owns targeting, charges, cooldowns, and locking.
libtetrisbrain only applies the selected board transform.
Remove top n rows, shift stack up,
Drop suspended cells to the bottom
Remove bottom n rows, shift stack down,
Overwrite bottom n rows with garbage,
All functions mutate the caller-owned t_board in place and return void.
Invalid sizes are ignored or clamped; out-of-range cell targets are ignored.
